h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thoothukudi

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thoothukudi

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thoothukudi

c: Thoothukudi is a port city ringed by salt pans, with a dry, hot climate and steady sea breeze. Salt in the air is the main enemy of outdoor metal here. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thoothukudi for port and industrial townships, schools, colleges, parks and residential layouts. We make our machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,310 km away, and deliver them to Tamil Nadu by road.

Rain here is lower than in most of the state, and comes mainly with the northeast monsoon late in the year. That leaves long dry months when parks and township grounds are used every evening. An open gym in one of these places gives residents free daily exercise. We send a layout drawing first, then manufacture and install through our team or a dealer in south India.

richText.heading: Keeping outdoor gym equipment in shape near the sea

c: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist salt far better than painted mild steel. Even so, a coastal gym lasts longer with a simple routine. Rinse the frames with fresh water every few weeks, wipe the moving parts and check bolts during the monthly round.

items.q: How often should coastal outdoor gym equipment be rinsed?
items.a: Every few weeks with fresh water, and after any storm that brings sea spray inland. This removes salt deposits from the frames and moving parts.

items.q: Can port and industrial townships order outdoor gyms?
items.a: Yes. Townships often place an open gym in a central park or near staff quarters. Send us the site details and we will prepare a layout drawing and quote.
